user.title: Add a Bliss blind
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of the blind. Pair and set up the blind in the Hunter Douglas app first.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add Bliss blind?
bluetooth_confirm.description: Found a Bliss blind advertising as {name} at {address}. Add it only once nothing else is holding the Bluetooth connection - a blind accepts ONE connection at a time, and the Hunter Douglas app or another integration will fight this one for it.

error.invalid_mac: That is not a valid MAC address. Use the form AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

abort.no_discovery_info: The details of this blind were lost before it could be added. Wait for it to be discovered again, or add it by hand.

data_description.maintenance_mode: ON makes this blind read-only: position, battery and health still update, but it cannot be moved. Off is normal behaviour.
data_description.connect_timeout: How long to keep trying to reach the motor before giving up. Raise it if a blind often fails with 'Cannot find blind'; lower it to give up faster.
data_description.speed: Speed used for every move. Slow is the slowest, Comfort the regular, and Standard the fastest of the three.
